page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.12xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. The instance is built with dedicated Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz, delivering 48 dedicated vCPUs. With an aggregate memory capacity of 384.0 GB, the configuration maintains a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per allocated virtual core.

Hardware resource allocation excludes integrated local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, requiring primary data storage to rely on external network-attached volumes. Networking capabilities include a baseline throughput of 25 Gbps, supporting high-bandwidth cluster coordination and distributed environment connectivity without bundled complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The 1:8 memory distribution provides balanced computational density for RAM-intensive deployments. It suits production in-memory databases, distributed caching nodes, memory-heavy enterprise analytics, and large ETL data processing pipelines that demand substantial dedicated memory headroom without requiring local disk caching or hardware acceleration.

The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and incorporates a 25 Gbps baseline network interface to manage high-throughput inter-node traffic. There is no bundled local storage, meaning all data persistence relies on external cloud volumes, and it includes zero dedicated GPU hardware. This hardware profile delivers predictable compute and high RAM density, targeting in-memory caches, distributed databases, large-scale transaction processing, and enterprise resource planning systems that demand large operational working sets.
